llm_fields.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to unemployed scheduled‑caste leather artisans to start or expand small‑scale enterprises, aiming to empower artisans and improve their livelihoods.
llm_fields.eligibility: Applicant must be a leather artisan belonging to specified scheduled‑caste sub‑castes, be at least 18 years old, have annual family income not exceeding ₹30,000 in rural areas or ₹25,000 in urban areas, not have received benefits from other schemes (except training), and have no family members employed in government or semi‑government organisations.
